summary: The media files the CIA recovered from al-Qaeda leader Osama bin Laden's hideout in Abbottabad, Pakistan, where he lived from 2006 until US forces killed him in 2011, after a short sketch of his life.

evidence.note: host says he dropped the planned biography to focus mostly on the hard drive files
short life overview opens with the 1957 birth, father and childhood
his press office, ignored declarations and obsession with news coverage of himself
move to Afghanistan, training camps and the cave hideout around 9/11
moves into the Abbottabad compound in 2006; courier-carried internet access
2015 FOIA request and CIA refusal over the porn found in the raid
theory that al-Qaeda hid operational documents inside porn files; Berlin arrest example
CIA's November 2017 release of about 470,000 files from the raid
catalogue of films, documentaries, anime, cartoons and games on the drives
Christian conspiracy tract about the Illuminati card game found in his files

notes: partial_life set: the host says up front the episode is mostly the seized hard drive, with only a ~13-minute life overview. covered_span still starts at 1957 because that overview spends real time on his childhood, and ends at the 2017 CIA release the episode is built on (2015 FOIA fight included). main_span is the Abbottabad years the files document.
